digest.component_or_area: review-bot tickets clone convergence and deployment
propositions: The persistent tickets clone on EBS-backed external volume diverges during redeploy because the entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, and convergence logic is missing from the ensure script.

The ensure script must fetch with explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets, handle absent credentials gracefully without aborting an already-cast vote, and preserve local-only commits via reconverge for compatible stores.

Pre-epoch clones must adopt newly fetched epoch-bearing commits via a narrow, precondition-gated reset path only when the local tip is an ancestor of the prior remote tip, refusing adoption in all ahead/diverged/corrupt/missing cases.
The autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS must include infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh so that script changes automatically trigger deployment without requiring manual bootstrap.

Convergence must remain best-effort outside the PAT block and must never undo or wedge an already-cast Gerrit vote, with all failures preserving the exact local tip and emitting operator-readable warnings.
